messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: [HIGH] gpu_vmem_surge detected in pool=west-eu-rtx-2 | metric=gpu_memory.used_pct | value=94% | active_hosts=3 :rotating_light:
carla_oncall: acked via PagerDuty. I'm looking. tagging @sre_jamie and @alice_ml for visibility. any immediate customer-facing impact?
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-112233 created and triggered to on-call. Escalation policy: SRE Primary -> SRE Lead after 3m.
sre_jamie: on my way. can you paste the node list and top processes?
carla_oncall: grabbing quick ps and nvidia-smi output, will paste shortly.
carla_oncall: ```
NODE: gpu-west-eu-01
GPU0: 94% used, processes: 
 - pid 2314: model_server (open-llm) user=redwood weight=3.2GB
 - pid 4452: batch-worker user=infra weight=6.1GB
GPU1: 92% used, similar pattern
NODE: gpu-west-eu-02
GPU0: 96% used, pid 9981: experimental-load (unknown) 9.8GB
```
megan_support: seeing a spike in errors from dedicated customers in eu-west, ~10% 503s in last 3m, ticket volume up.
carla_oncall: hypothesis: KV cache blowup + a runaway batch job on gpu-west-eu-02. planning to cordon + drain the offending node, and gracefully move live traffic.
sre_jamie: agree. steps: 1) mark node cordoned 2) gracefully drain model pods with --max-surge 0 and redirect new requests to fallback variant 3) kill runaway pid if drain stalls.
carla_oncall: running drain now: ```kubectl cordon gpu-west-eu-02 && kubectl drain gpu-west-eu-02 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60```
carla_oncall: drain started, some pods are stuck Pending because they request GPUs and no spare capacity yet.
sre_jamie: temporary mitigation: increase pool capacity by bringing up a hot-standby node in west-eu (spin up one c5-gpu-hot), and enable CPU fallback route for low-priority traffic. I'll trigger autoscale and set routing policy.
sre_jamie: ```sql
# increase capacity (internal infra tool)
infractl scale pool west-eu-rtx-2 +1 --image=rtx-server:v2.4-hotstandby
```
alice_ml: looping in model team: @alice_ml here, we can shrink KV cache TTL for the problematic model to free 2-3GB per replica. pushing a config change now.
carla_oncall: config patch applied to model_server on gpu-west-eu-01 and 02: reduced kv_cache.max_items=10000 -> 4000. observing memory drop on GPU0 of gpu-west-eu-01: 94% -> 78% within 20s. :thumbsup:
sre_jamie: nice. still want to kill that experimental process on gpu-west-eu-02 (pid 9981) after we confirm traffic shifted. carla, can you ssh and check logs for that pid?
carla_oncall: ssh'd and tailing logs. it's a one-off load test that somehow leaked into production. I'll kill and note in PD incident.```
carla_oncall: sudo kill -9 9981 -> process terminated. GPU1 usage dropping to 61%.
megan_support: error rate starting to ramp down, customer-facing 503s down from 10% -> 2% in last 4m. posting a quick status update to SLO board and support with ETA 15m for full recovery.
sre_jamie: good. set canary to verify performance on the new hot-standby before shifting all traffic. also create a temporary reroute rule: route requests above 1000ms to dedicated fallback variant.
carla_oncall: canary passing on hot-standby, increasing pool capacity completed. drain for gpu-west-eu-02 finished successfully, node marked unschedulable.
incident-bot: NOTE: alert auto-resolve pending. If further OOM spikes occur within 10m, incident will reopen.
alice_ml: followup action items: 1) add a hard limit on experimental-load jobs to prevent prod runaways 2) add KV cache mem guard with eviction on threshold 85% 3) add annotation to pool with runbook link. I'll open a PR for #1 and #2.
carla_oncall: adding runbook link to incident ticket and tagging infra for quota enforcement. @megan_support please send a brief to customers hit (we already have draft).
megan_support: will send: "We saw transient GPU memory pressure affecting some requests in EU, root cause: leaked load-test job + cache TTL. Services recovered after node drain and cache TTL patch. Full mitigation and followups are in progress."
carla_oncall: handing off to next on-call @alice_ml for followups and postmortem. I'll stay on-call for any immediate escalations for the next 10m.
alice_ml: taking over. my checklist: verify autoscale logs, confirm PRs, runbook updates, and coordinate postmortem.
carla_oncall: thanks team. incident state: mitigated -> monitoring. leaving thread. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-112233 status: acknowledged -> resolved (auto-resolved by oncall).
incident-bot: INCIDENT SUMMARY: GPU memory pressure in west-eu-rtx-2 caused by runaway experimental process + KV cache TTL. Customer impact: transient 503s for some eu-west dedicated customers. Mitigation: node drain, hot-standby spin-up, KV cache TTL reduction, kill runaway process. Actions: infra quota enforcement, KV cache guard, runbook link.
